raw_jobs.title: Associate Commercial Counsel
raw_jobs.description_html:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Commercial & Marketing Legal (CoMa) team is the legal engine behind Discord's revenue and partnership business. We partner with Global Partnerships, Developer & Platform Solutions, Corporate Strategy, Ad Solutions, Data Science, AdTech, Marketing, and Procurement to structure and close the deals that bring games, creators, and brands to Discord's community. As Associate Commercial Counsel, you'll be a key advisor for integrating Discord's social features into games, enabling in-game commerce and digital collectibles, and building new monetization models alongside some of the biggest names in gaming and entertainment. You will also support our marketing and events teams on creative endeavors that promote Discord in the industry and to users. You'll handle a high volume of deals with real ownership, and you'll help shape how Discord approaches new partnership types at scale. This person will report to the Managing Counsel, Commercial & Marketing Legal.

What you'll be doing:

  • Draft, negotiate, and close a high volume of commercial agreements. These include Advertising, API and SDK integration agreements, commerce and in-app purchase agreements, and ad tech related transactions.
  • Negotiate IP licensing agreements with game, anime, and entertainment licensors for digital collectibles and in-app content.
  • Review, advise on, and support sponsorship and marketing efforts.
  • Structure novel monetization and revenue models, such as virtual currency, bundled subscriptions, rewards programs, and revenue share. 
  • Support payments and platform agreements, including payment processors, gift card distribution, and app store and developer program terms.
  • Build and maintain scalable templates, playbooks, and self-serve processes, including simplifying complex agreements into modular, easy-to-use forms.

What you should have:

  • A JD and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar. You also need to be eligible to register as in-house counsel in California.
  • At least 4 years of commercial transactional experience, with a combination of top law firm and/or in-house experience at a technology company preferred.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements, such as technology licensing, platform integrations, and revenue partnerships.
  • Experience with advertising, gaming, digital media, data privacy and consumer internet.
  • Understanding of privacy principles, especially with respect to commercial agreements involving the transfer or personal information.
  • Familiarity with marketing legal issues, including copyright, privacy, and consumer protection principles.
  • The ability to manage a high-volume docket while prioritizing effectively and meeting business timelines.
  • Sound business judgment and the ability to give practical, risk-calibrated advice in fast-moving, ambiguous situations.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal issues for non-lawyer stakeholders and run with work independently.

Bonus points:

  • Familiarity with payments, virtual currency, or subscription and bundling arrangements.
  • Experience with international or APAC counterparties.

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Base Salary
$200,000—$225,000 USD

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

raw_jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Machine Learning (Safety)
raw_jobs.description_html:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord's Safety ML team builds the machine learning systems that protect 200M+ users. The team's mission is to make Discord a place where people can build genuine friendships without exposure to harm, at a scale where manual review alone can never keep up.

We're looking for a highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Engineering Manager to lead our Safety ML team. As the manager responsible for Safety ML, you will own the detection systems that sit between attackers and our users; real-time and batch models for content understanding, account integrity, and platform abuse.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and lead an exceptional team of highly-engaged ML engineers by hiring, coaching, and instilling a sense of ownership and impact.
  • Drive the technical vision and roadmap for Safety ML by collaborating with your team and partners across Trust & Safety, Product, Policy, Legal, and Data Science.
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of production safety models: defining new capabilities, measuring performance, and monitoring the operational health of systems that make millions of enforcement decisions per day.
  • Manage processes and leverage your technical expertise to continually raise the bar and ensure your team delivers extraordinary results.
  • Partner with Trust & Safety on label quality, golden sets, and automating manual investigations.
  • Work with other Engineering Managers to continuously improve the Engineering organization and uphold our workplace philosophy.

What you should have

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, or Applied Scientist.
  • You have 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and successfully managed a team of 5+ engineers.
  • You have hands-on depth in at least one of: abuse/fraud detection, content classification, behavioral modeling, graph-based modeling, or LLM-based classification systems.
  • You have strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally.
  • You thrive in ambiguous environments and get excited about figuring out solutions to complex problems, and then executing on them.
  • You are a first principles thinker that can work with others to come up with pragmatic solutions.
  • You have a proven record of shipping ML systems to production at scale.
  • You are passionate about coaching and leading other engineers, but can roll up your sleeves and get elbow deep in code when needed.

raw_jobs.title: Senior Staff Brand Designer
raw_jobs.description_html:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there's one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

This is a new role, on a new team. The Brand Team sits alongside Design Systems in Design Foundations and keeps Discord's identity, voice, and visual system consistent across every surface where the brand appears. We run the brand like an internal product: we set its strategy, build and maintain its guidelines and tools, enable other teams to use it on their own, and review brand-facing work across product, marketing, partnerships, and legal. Marketing is a client of Brand: we equip their work with a brand that stays clear and current, while campaigns, ads, and launch messaging stay theirs to run.

You're a brand designer with gaming in your bones who can set the vision and do the work. You think in systems: logo, color, type, iconography, illustration, and motion are parts of one identity, and you know how to write the rules that keep it coherent when hundreds of people use it. You're as comfortable presenting brand architecture to executives as you are refining a wordmark. You're a generous partner who grounds every decision in reasoning rather than taste, and you'd rather teach a team to use the brand well than gatekeep it.

This person will report to the Director of Product Design, Design Foundations.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Defining Discord's brand strategy: positioning, brand architecture across the master brand and sub-brands like Nitro (Discord's premium subscription), and the narrative of what Discord stands for and for whom
  • Owning and evolving Discord's visual identity system, including logo, wordmark, color, typography, iconography, illustration, and motion
  • Building and maintaining brand and sub-brand guidelines, including standards for co-branding, partnerships, and third-party integrations, and partnering with Voice & Tone and User Communications to bring the Voice & Writing Guide into the brand system
  • Building templates, design kits, asset libraries, and a self-serve brand portal, and enabling teams to use the brand on their own through office hours, a support channel, onboarding, and workshops
  • Reviewing and approving brand-facing work across marketing, product, and partnerships, and working with Legal on trademark and usage policy
  • Applying the brand directly on core surfaces, including app icons, deck templates, the marketing site design system, office spaces, signage, and merch, and art-directing the external partners who help produce them
  • Running an annual brand audit across every surface, monitoring the competitive landscape, and mentoring future Brand team members

What you should have

  • 10+ years of experience in brand or identity design, including owning a brand system at scale for a gaming or games-adjacent brand
  • A portfolio with exemplary craft across identity, typography, color, iconography, illustration, and motion, applied across digital product, marketing, and physical spaces, with your role on each project clearly shown
  • A track record of brand strategy work, including positioning, brand architecture, and sub-brand systems
  • Experience writing brand guidelines and governance models and running them over time: maintaining them, holding teams accountable to them, and evolving them as they're tested in real use
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you've built a brand practice where there was no playbook, and you're willing to do the hands-on work while setting direction
  • A demonstrated ability to align stakeholders at every level, from executives to individual designers, with clear reasoning and strong presentation skills
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and agents in brand work, and a clear point of view on where AI helps craft and where it doesn't

Bonus Points

  • Experience standing up a brand function, brand portal, or DAM (digital asset management system) from scratch
  • Experience with co-branding and partnership governance, or trademark and usage compliance
  • Experience working alongside a design systems team, including Figma libraries and variables

raw_jobs.title: Account Executive - Commercial, Spotify Technology
raw_jobs.description_html:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

What You'll Do

    • Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand.

    • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close.

    • Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM.

    • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

    • Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion.

    • Partner with Marketing on inbound and outbound pipeline generation, responding quickly to leads and identifying new opportunities.

    • Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development.

    • Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

    • Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products.

    • Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion.

    • Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

Who You Are

    • You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

    • You have a proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB) or mid-market companies.

    • You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process.

    • You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals.

    • You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams.

    • You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

    • You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

    • You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

    • You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

Where You'll Be

    This role is based in New York City

    We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $87,069-$124,385 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

raw_jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Music
raw_jobs.description_html:
Music Expression builds the tools artists use to show who they are on Spotify and to connect with fans. A song doesn't have to be just a track in a list. On Spotify it can come with a looping Canvas visual, a music video, a vertical-video clip from the artist, or a countdown to a new release. Release day can become a shared Listening Party. Every one of those things was built by this org. Each squad owns part of the artist-to-fan journey.

The work runs from video pipelines and serving infrastructure through mobile and web clients to rights systems, so engineers get real depth and range. Product, design, data science, research and product marketing work inside the squads, and they work directly with artists and labels. What you ship changes how artists show up on Spotify and how fans experience their music. If you want to work where technology meets creativity and culture, this is the place.

If this role excites you but you don't meet every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain scalable backend services (Java)

  • Be an active part of creating and evolving APIs and services that connect user experiences with internal scalable infrastructure, while applying product requirements

  • Drive improvements to system architecture, performance, and developer experience

  • Develop and enhance our user-facing layer and frontend SDKs (React/Typescript)

  • Collaborate closely with a talented group of engineers, product managers, designers and data specialists across multiple teams

  • Contribute to technical discussions and help shape platform decisions

Who You Are

  • You are experienced in designing and developing backend applications in Java.

  • You have a solid understanding of React, and TypeScript and are passionate about delivering end-to-end experiences and software architecture across the back-end, front-end, and the APIs that glue them together.

  • You have a growth mindset, are curious, and are not afraid to be experimental. You share your ideas and continuously improve yourself and the team around you.

  • Experience with infrastructure-related technologies is a plus.

  • You care about agile software development and a culture of constant learning and improvement.

  • You have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and can communicate your ideas.

  • You have experience and passion for mentoring and encouraging collaborative teams.

Where You'll Be

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the ET time zone as long as we have a work location. 

The United States base range for this position is $132,948 - $189,927 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays. This range encompasses multiple levels. Leveling is determined during the interview process. Placement in a level depends on relevant work history and interview performance. These ranges may be modified in the future.


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

raw_jobs.title: Global Creative Lead, Reverb
raw_jobs.description_html:
Spotify's in-house creative studio, Reverb, brings our brand to life through thoughtful design, visual storytelling, and creative production. Working across brand and communications, the team creates work that connects with audiences around the world.

We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers. You'll combine creative vision with hands-on leadership, helping the team deliver distinctive, high-quality work while building an environment where people can collaborate, experiment, and grow.

Reporting to the Director, Global Experiential & Content Production, you'll play a key role in shaping the studio's creative output and how we work together.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 graphic designers, motion designers, and producers, supporting their creative growth and career development.

    • Shape the visual and motion design direction across Reverb projects, creating distinctive work that brings Spotify's brand and stories to life.

    • Partner with teams across brand, communications, marketing, and production to turn creative briefs into engaging visual experiences across channels and formats.

    • Guide creative development from concept through delivery, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and thoughtful design decisions.

    • Manage project intake, priorities, budgets, timelines, and resources to help the team deliver meaningful work across multiple projects.

    • Collaborate with Reverb's creative and production leads to build a connected, effective studio and a consistent creative experience.

    • Present creative concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders, explaining the thinking behind decisions and building alignment.

    • Work with internal teams and external creative partners to maintain design quality, manage production needs, and navigate relevant legal and licensing requirements.

Who You Are

    • You bring 8+ years of experience in graphic design, visual design, or a related creative discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong visual storytelling, brand identity, and motion design.

    • You have 4+ years of experience leading creative teams, with a thoughtful approach to coaching, feedback, and helping others develop their craft.

    • You're comfortable shaping creative direction across digital, social, advertising, editorial, and long-form brand content, adapting your approach to different audiences and formats.

    • You have experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and relevant visual or motion design tools, and you're curious about how emerging technologies can support the creative process.

    • You know how to balance creative ambition with practical delivery, making thoughtful decisions around timelines, budgets, and resources.

    • You communicate creative ideas clearly and enjoy collaborating with designers, producers, and partners across different disciplines and regions.

    • You have experience working with external creative studios, production companies, and partners, including managing budgets, contracts, and production workflows.

    • You care about creating an inclusive, supportive team environment where different perspectives are valued, feedback is welcomed, and people can do their best work.

Where You'll Be

    • This role is based in New York City.

    • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! We ask that you come into the office 1-2x per week.

raw_jobs.title: Security Engineer, Cloud
raw_jobs.description_html:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

The Security Engineering team helps make Ramp the most secure place for our customers to collect, manage, and put to work their business’ financial information 

Our work centers in three areas:

  • Ramp builds products with an eye for security

  • Ramp detects and responds to threats before they cause harm

  • Security powers Ramp’s growth

Check out our Engineering Blog for more on our tech stack, mission and values!

What You’ll Do

  • Drive our cloud security roadmap: review our cloud deployments to identify opportunities for improvement

  • Design and build security-focused infrastructure primitives and integrate them into our existing products and development processes

  • Lead remediation of prioritized issues across our technology stack

  • Partner with infrastructure, data, and devops teams to design and deploy solutions that are inherently secure

What You Need

  • Minimum 5 years of experience building software

  • Minimum 3 years of experience building in AWS (with Terraform)

  • A strong sense of ownership: you need to drive projects from inception to scaling it in production

  • Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, continuously grow, and master your craft

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Python (Flask) and Terraform

  • Experience with Azure, GCP, and other cloud providers

  • Experience improving the developer experience and security properties of a multi-service deployment

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

raw_jobs.description_html:
🌍 Redefining how people live.

At Blueground, we believe that when your base is reliable, the world opens up. That's why we're building the world's leading platform for living.

Every year, 350 million people move between cities—yet today's housing options haven't caught up with the needs of this modern, mobile generation. Blueground was built to change that.

With 40,000+ homes across the globe, available for stays from a few days to a year or more, we're just getting started. We're on an exponential growth path to redefine living and create an entirely new category. Our edge? Powerful proprietary tech, operational excellence, and a team that executes with speed and discipline.

Our culture is grounded in five principles:

Guests First – Every decision starts with their experience. Move Fast – We value speed, momentum, and action. Dive In – The magic is always in the details, and we go deep. Embrace Change – Change isn't a disruption; it's how we grow. Keep It Honest – Transparency accelerates progress—and strengthens relationships.

If you're ready to do the best work of your life and help reshape how the world lives, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Admin based in Brazil to support our sales team by owning the administrative and client-facing steps that take a booking from signed to moved in.

The Sales Admin is responsible for managing pre-move-in client communications, completing guest screening and background requirements, coordinating arrivals, and setting up bookings accurately in our internal systems. This role works closely with sales, housing sourcing, and operations teams while serving as a reliable point of contact for clients and guests.

If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrive on keeping many moving pieces on track in a fast-paced environment, this role may be a great fit.

What you will focus on

  • Own pre move-in client communications, including sending move-in hand-off emails with everything clients and guests need before arrival
  • Manage background requirements by generating background documentation and sending it to clients for review
  • Follow up with clients and guests to ensure background checks are completed on time
  • Locate and route background documents through the correct e-signature workflow
  • Screen guests through SafeRent Solutions and track results to completion
  • Coordinate pet and parking registrations with clients and property partners
  • Communicate changes of date (COD), changes of address (COA), and cancellations with clients, keeping all parties aligned
  • Run daily arrivals audits to confirm upcoming bookings are complete, accurate, and move-in ready
  • Send manual arrivals emails when automated communications don't apply
  • Set up bookings in BlueB, including creating buildings, properties (POs), and Deal Sheet (DS) records
  • Maintain accurate records across internal systems so sales, sourcing, and operations teams have up-to-date information
  • Partner with internal teams to resolve issues quickly and deliver a smooth move-in experience for every guest
  • Sense of Urgency & Prioritization: Ability to effectively prioritize competing tasks in a fast-paced environment, with client communication and time-sensitive requests taking priority.
  • Client Advocacy & Problem-Solving: Proactively explore alternative solutions and available options to achieve the best possible outcomes for clients while ensuring their needs remain the top priority.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales support, administration, corporate housing, hospitality, real estate, property management, or a related field
  • Exceptional organizational skills and ability to manage multiple bookings and deadlines simultaneously
  • High attention to detail when processing documents, screenings, and system entries
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills with clients and guests
  • Strong follow-through and ability to keep tasks moving without close supervision
  • Familiarity with tenant screening, background checks, or lease/onboarding paperwork is a plus
  • Proficiency in Google suite and comfort learning internal systems for data entry and tracking
  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset and ability to move quickly in a fast-paced environment

From furniture installation and basic repairs to liaising with specialist contractors and supporting our guests with in-stay issues, you’ll play a vital role in delivering an exceptional living experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Property Maintenance & Repairs: Carry out general repairs and maintenance tasks, including carpentry, light painting, plumbing, electrical troubleshooting, and appliance fixes.
  • Installations & Upgrades: Install and assemble furniture, lighting, mirrors, and other home furnishings according to Blueground’s design and quality standards.
  • Apartment Inspections: Conduct detailed walkthroughs to ensure each apartment is in perfect condition; document issues and generate lists for follow-up.
  • Contractor Coordination: Liaise with external specialists (plumbers, electricians, appliance engineers) when complex repairs are needed. Oversee service delivery and ensure follow-up checks are completed.
  • Guest Support: Respond promptly to maintenance-related guest concerns to ensure a seamless living experience.
  • Inventory & Deliveries: Support the operations team by delivering small household items to properties when needed (glassware, lighting, kitchen equipment, etc.).

Requirements

  • Experience (at least 3 years) as a General Maintenance / Repairs Technician or in a similar role
  • Proven experience in repairing Home Appliances Experience in spare parts and knowledge of suppliers to source them. 
  • Eye for details, and ability to inspect apartments and provide accurate reports/snag list. 
  • Strong knowledge of maintenance/technical procedures and practices Client-oriented with very good communication skills

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus (up to 15% based on performance)

raw_jobs.title: AML Manager, Austria
raw_jobs.description_html:
At bunq, we’re more than a bank. We’re on a mission to make banking work for people wherever they live in Europe. With local IBANs, our users can pay rent, sign up for the gym and get paid like a local from day one. Every successful transaction is a step toward making them feel at home and letting us truly “Make Life Easy.”

Austria is next, and we need someone on the ground to make it happen. As our AML Manager Austria, you’ll be bunq’s accountable local owner of compliance in Austria. You’ll help bring bunq into the market through the EU passporting process, then run AML operations, integrity risk and financial crime reporting for the country. You won’t have a local team. Instead, you’ll build and use AI tools that let one person cover what a traditional bank staffs with a full department.

Think you’re up for the challenge? Join us in making a real impact on users’ lives while scaling AML operations across Europe 🚀

What you’ll own

  • Lead bunq’s entry into Austria by shaping the local content for the passporting notification to the FMA, including the business plan, organizational and operational setup, localization requirements and timelines, and set up your reporting line into HQ Compliance from day one

  • Adapt bunq’s AML/CFT framework to Austrian law, own the integrity risk assessment (SIRA) and oversee FIU reporting, using AI-first processes that keep the branch compliant and every filing on time

  • Be bunq’s trusted contact for the FMA, leading supervisory dialogues, audits and inspections

  • You live in Austria and are fluent in German and English

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Austrian AML/CFT framework and FMA requirements, ideally from 7+ years in AML, fraud, KYC or CDD

  • Experience contributing to a regulatory notification or licensing process, such as EU passporting or a banking/EMI license application

  • A track record of owning a compliance program end to end and using AI tools to automate the work

  • Sound regulatory judgment and a feel for balancing risk with the needs of a fast-growing tech company

  • Nice to have: experience with AML inspections or regulatory audits, or with a role that owned several compliance areas at once.

Your space to perform

We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪🏼

🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset

🌟 Make lasting impact by working on complex & exciting challenges

👩‍💻 Remote setup: after 3 weeks onboarding in Amsterdam (“AMS”) office, work 2 weeks a quarter in AMS - the rest of time you can work in Austria.

💰 A competitive base annual salary range €108,000-€119,700, and final offer will be based on the candidate’s qualifications and competencies.

📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget

🚌 Travel expenses are covered for AMS visits

💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us

🧘 €60 monthly allowance that rolls over monthly and resets annually, replacing the phone/internet line above

🍹 Frequent epic events, including an annual bunq weekend away

All new hires are subject to Pre-employment Screening (PES), which includes checks conducted by our third-party partner, Zinc. This is part of our commitment to a secure and trustworthy workplace.

raw_jobs.title: Technical Writer, Customer Education
raw_jobs.description_html:
Why is this position open

Channable’s product offering is broad, complex, and always improving. Across our five modules, new features and improvements are made every day. Over the last two years, the Customer Education team has focused on supporting the Product and Engineering teams by creating comprehensive product documentation and Academy courses for each major release, ensuring our customers understand our products, onboard themselves, and get to value faster. 

Now we’re looking for a Technical Writer to help us further develop and improve our educational materials, representing and reflecting the voice of the customer.

Channable sits between eCommerce tools like Shopify and channels like Google Shopping. When Shopify changes its API or Google updates its product feed rules, our integrations change, and our docs need to follow. As a Technical Writer, you'll learn to track those changes and turn them into accurate help content our customers rely on.

We also get a lot of feedback, tips and ideas from our customers and our knowledgeable customer-facing colleagues in the Support, CS, and Sales departments. You will investigate, centralize, write and publish this internal knowledge to our Help Center and Academy.

The Customer Education team is composed of a Team Lead, Academy Program Manager, Technical Content Designer, Technical Writer, and Motion Graphic Designer.

Your role

  • Write, edit, and fact-check product documentation in the Help Center.

  • Write, edit, and fact-check courses in the Academy.

  • Review product updates and feedback from customer-facing colleagues, and update documentation to reflect changes.

  • Work with Technical Writers and Technical Content Designers to adapt and improve your writing style, in line with our Style Guide.

  • Collaborate with subject matter experts from Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, and more to learn about specific concepts.

Who are you?

  • You have at least 1 year’s experience in Technical Writing, UX Copywriting, Content Marketing, Communications, Engineering, or another related field.

  • You care about clarity, consistency, and correctness.

  • You can convey complex matters in simple terms.

  • You can work to tight deadlines, and adapt to shifting priorities.

  • You can build clarity out of technical challenges and incomplete inputs.

  • You have an excellent written and verbal command of the English language.

  • You have strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate with, and harvest information from, a wide range of people with a wide variety of priorities.

  • You have a growth mindset, and enjoy working with a team to deliver collaborative projects.

Other requirements

  • You are living in the Netherlands, within travelling distance of our Utrecht office.

  • You are willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week.

  • You're available for at least 4 days/week (32 hours).

Who are we?

Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open-minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn! Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

What do we offer?

The salary range based on a 40-hour work week is between gross €2.976 and €4.252. 

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with the May salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of € 1000 to spend on anything you want to learn. You can take full advantage of this to grow professionally.

  • Saving for old age - we have a saving scheme for old age which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Traveling to our office? No problem, we got you covered. (NS Business Card, or €0,25 per km if you decide to use a different means of transport) 🚆

  • Our beautiful, fully renovated historic office in central Utrecht offers a hybrid working policy, requiring just two days in the office per week.

  • Since you can work from home, we will provide home office supplies. 🖥️⌨️

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours.

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks, if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! 🍹

  • Having flexible working hours means starting your day between 8.00 - 10.00 am. 🕰️

  • We want you to feel good - please feel free to use our discounted Urban Sports Club subscription.

  • You have free & anonymous access to the OpenUp platform and psychologists. This free service is also available to your family members.

  • Are you going to become a parent? We think it is important that you spend time with your newborn. Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • At Channable, our Chef and Commis Chef prepare fresh meals Monday to Thursday, catering to all dietary needs - including vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free - to keep our team fueled and inspired! To round out the week, Fridays feature delicious ordered-in sandwiches and salads. Or, you can go to the city center to get the lunch of your choice.

  • Channaweekend - Every year we go for a long weekend with all our colleagues from all over the world. 💜🔥

  • Channaweek - We believe in bringing people together. That’s why we organize global events like Channaweek where our entire international team gathers in Utrecht to connect and learn from one another.

  • Additional working conditions like massages, in-office bar (Channabar), parties, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, and many more!

How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? Apply by clicking on the "apply now" button below. Please send your application in English.

Include your CV, a cover letter, and a brief video (no more than 2-minutes long) to show us a little bit about yourself, and why you’re interested in this role. 

Interview steps:

  1. Round 1: 45-minute online interview with Caitlin (Technical Content Designer).

  2. Round 2: In-office assignment and interview with Caitlin and Sofie (your future team lead), followed by an interview with Michel (Head of Growth), and a coffee and office tour from your future team (90 minutes total).

  3. Please note that after the interviews, and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.

We consider applications as they come in. We look forward to hearing from you!

Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration. We believe in diverse and inclusive teams
